## Overview

Bristol-Myers Squibb is named as a funder of both [apixaban](./apixaban.md) trials in the supplied sources: ARISTOTLE and AVERROES were each funded by Bristol-Myers Squibb and [Pfizer](./pfizer.md) ([src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_81e343c146c92d15d7c2f15b65748ce1.md), [src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405](viking://user/ulab0001/resources/p/pmed01/sources/src_ee77d1914d18a5ece9857b4e40a81405.md)).
